rationale: The papers 'Observational Signatures of Supermassive Black Hole Binaries' (2310.16896) and 'Multi-messenger Time-domain Signatures Of Supermassive Black Hole Binaries' (2110.14661) discuss the existence and observational signatures of SMBH binaries, which relates to the tension in the question, but do not provide definitive evidence to resolve it.
